schema_version.description: The positive integer version of the canonical row schema.

repository_id.description: Immutable provider repository ID within its forge host.

merge_id.description: Stable id for this pull request merge boundary.

org_id.description: The deployment's tenant id, normalized. Bound to the server.

provider.description: Which system this fact came from.

repo.description: `owner/repo`, lowercased. Empty string when the sender omitted it.

pr_number.description: The positive pull request number within the repository.

head_repo.description: The repository that supplied the pull request head.

head_repository_provider.description: Captured head repository provider, independent of the target identity.

head_repository_host.description: Captured head repository host, independent of the target identity.

head_repository_id.description: Captured immutable head repository ID, independent of the target identity.

head_ref.description: The normalized final pull request head branch.

head_sha.description: The final pull request head commit.

base_ref.description: The normalized target branch at merge time.

base_sha.description: The target branch commit recorded by the merge event.

merged_at.description: When the forge recorded the pull request merge.

source_event_id.description: The provider delivery identity when supplied.

captured_at.description: When Sediment stored the fact, stamped server-side. Windows and ordering anchor on this, never on a client clock.
